name: Borin Stonebell

textures.Normal: linear, tangent +Y, flat normal surface; geometric bevels

equipment: weighted within the skeletal mesh; socket bones also available

source_brief.silhouette: A compact rectangular torso beneath a domed helmet, with wide rounded shoulder plates and an oversized bell-headed hammer. Short legs stay separated enough to read during motion.
source_brief.face: Ruddy tan skin, large brown brows and a thick brown beard divided into two broad braids. A hinged-looking open helmet never hides the eyes.
source_brief.costume: Slate plate over a moss-green padded coat, heavy riveted boots and a wide belt with a single square buckle. Avoid dozens of small rivets; bake secondary details.
source_brief.palette: Slate #697A88; moss #6B7750; muted bronze #A58354; warm beard brown #76533A.
source_brief.equipment: A two-handed fantasy hammer shaped like a solid bell housing. Its broad rim helps the stomp animation read without an actual moving bell interior.
source_brief.signature: Domed open helmet, paired beard braids and bell-shaped hammer head.
source_brief.materials: Rough forged metal, thick wool and a few worn bronze edges. Metal highlights should be broader and less bright than Ada’s polished crest.
source_brief.back: Overlapping short backplates terminate above the hips. Beard and shoulder plates need separate clearance zones during a downward cast.
source_brief.animation: Idle rocks only slightly with the heavy hammer resting low. Walk is a deliberate short stride. Basics deliver compact side impacts. The active raises one foot and stamps while the hammer settles, emphasizing the ring on the ground.
source_brief.vfx: A single amber ground ring and a clear stun marker over affected enemies. The ring has no damage component and no lingering slow.
source_brief.audio: A low, short bell knock with a firm footfall. Do not layer a long reverberation for each affected target.
source_brief.risk: Large shoulders and beard can hide the head at the gameplay angle; shorten the rear plate depth and test three Borins standing adjacent.

exported_coordinate_units: centimeters: temporary geometry, rest translation and animation location values multiplied by100; authoring source remains meters
